title: U.S. flight project data catalog
scope: Passenger flight route and schedule suggestions nationwide. Includes Alaska, Hawaii and explicitly tagged territories.
completeness: Broad primary-source catalog, not a claim that every local or privately licensed dataset has been inventoried.
collection_state: Documentation researched. No upstream bulk data bytes are included; source downloads were blocked in this workspace.

sources.name: FAA NASR airport and facility data
sources.coverage: U.S. airports and landing facilities, including Alaska, Hawaii and territories; check each file scope.
sources.project_use: Official airport identifiers, coordinates, facilities, runways and weather-station links.
sources.limits: Many facilities have no passenger service. Effective date differs from publication date.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: OurAirports
sources.coverage: Global; filter U.S. and territories explicitly.
sources.project_use: Airport search, coordinates, IATA/ICAO/local codes, runways, frequencies and service flag.
sources.limits: Community data. A service flag does not prove that a flight operates on a requested date.
sources.reuse_notes: Public domain, as stated by OurAirports.

sources.name: airportsdata airport time zones
sources.coverage: Global airport directory.
sources.latest_period_verified: Current documentation checked; file contents not downloaded
sources.project_use: Map airport identifiers to IANA time zones and FAA location identifiers.
sources.limits: Current airports only; not a historical airport-code table. Some identifiers are internal codes.
sources.reuse_notes: MIT; retain the project license when redistributing its data or code.

sources.name: IANA time-zone database
sources.coverage: Worldwide time-zone rules.
sources.project_use: Correct local-time conversion, daylight-saving changes and overnight connections.
sources.limits: Use a named zone and date. A fixed UTC offset is insufficient.
sources.reuse_notes: Public-domain time-zone data; retain bundled notices.

sources.name: BTS airport history and code lookup tables
sources.coverage: Airports, city markets, airlines and other codes used by BTS.
sources.latest_period_verified: Current schema checked; individual exports not downloaded
sources.project_use: Join AirportID, AirportSeqID, CityMarketID and DOT airline identifiers across years.
sources.limits: Airport and airline display codes can be reused. Preserve date ranges and stable IDs.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA airport boardings and cargo totals
sources.coverage: U.S. commercial-service and other reporting airports.
sources.project_use: Airport importance, hub categories and checks on passenger coverage.
sources.limits: Annual totals are not current flight schedules or available seats.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: DOT Essential Air Service reports
sources.coverage: Subsidized small-community service; separate Alaska reports.
sources.project_use: Check small-community routes and carriers absent from large-airline performance files.
sources.limits: Contracted service and published status do not establish a date-specific bookable flight.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA airport capacity profiles
sources.coverage: Selected busy airports.
sources.project_use: Background for congestion and runway-capacity analysis.
sources.limits: Old planning assumptions; not current declared capacity or a live operating restriction.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA airport activity forecasts
sources.coverage: Airports in NPIAS; scope described by FAA.
sources.latest_period_verified: 2025 Terminal Area Forecast data; February 2026 page update
sources.project_use: Long-term airport demand and route-network research.
sources.limits: This FAA TAF means activity forecast. It differs from the aviation-weather TAF.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: BTS Reporting Carrier On-Time Performance
sources.coverage: Domestic nonstop flights of reporting operators; not every U.S. carrier.
sources.project_use: Flight-level scheduled and actual times, cancellations, diversions and delay labels.
sources.limits: Retrospective scheduled times cannot establish future service. Reporting coverage changes.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: BTS Marketing Carrier On-Time Performance
sources.coverage: Reporting marketing-airline networks and their operating carriers.
sources.project_use: Customer-facing brand comparisons and operating/marketing carrier mapping.
sources.limits: Overlaps reporting-carrier data. Do not append both files as independent flights.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: BTS T-100 Domestic Segment, All Carriers
sources.coverage: Reported U.S. domestic nonstop segments; filter passenger service.
sources.project_use: Observed route graph, monthly departures, capacity, passengers, distance and aircraft categories.
sources.limits: Monthly aggregates have no flight departure times. Separate passenger service from cargo and charter.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: BTS T-100 Domestic Market, All Carriers
sources.coverage: Reported domestic on-flight markets.
sources.project_use: On-flight passenger flows by carrier and airport pair.
sources.limits: An on-flight market differs from both a nonstop segment and a whole passenger itinerary.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: BTS DB1C / OD40 ticket survey
sources.coverage: Sampled reported airline passenger tickets; apply domestic itinerary filters.
sources.latest_period_verified: July 2026 listed for Ticket, Market, Coupon and Segment files
sources.project_use: Historical fares, passenger flows, itinerary paths and connection patterns.
sources.limits: 40% sample. Not live quotes or inventory. Use the current field definitions and ticket weights.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: BTS DB1B legacy ticket survey
sources.coverage: Historical ticket sample.
sources.project_use: Longer-run fare and itinerary baselines.
sources.limits: 10% sample. Keep separate from DB1C until schema, weighting and sampling changes are handled.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: DOT Domestic Airfare Consumer Report
sources.coverage: Top domestic city-pair markets; report scope is not all airports.
sources.latest_period_verified: 2026 Q1 report verified; separate BTS average-fare release covers 2026 Q2
sources.project_use: Simple route/city fare baselines and competition measures.
sources.limits: Averages are historical and may mix trip types. No current bookable fares.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: DOT Air Travel Consumer Report
sources.coverage: Reporting airline service measures.
sources.latest_period_verified: October 2026 report: August data; oversales 2026 Q2
sources.project_use: Baggage, wheelchair, oversales, complaint and service-quality context.
sources.limits: Airline-level averages do not establish a particular flight or passenger outcome.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: BTS Data Bank 20
sources.coverage: Certificated and commuter U.S. carriers; scheduled and nonscheduled activity.
sources.project_use: Traffic, capacity and load-factor checks at broader levels.
sources.limits: Aggregates overlap other BTS releases; do not add them to T-100 totals.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA OPSNET operations and delays
sources.coverage: FAA facility operations and delay reports.
sources.latest_period_verified: Documentation checked; exact latest public month not confirmed
sources.project_use: Airport/system congestion history independent of airline-reported delays.
sources.limits: Public access follows the 20th of the next month. Definitions differ from airline arrival delay.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA ASPM performance data
sources.coverage: Selected airports and performance measures.
sources.project_use: Airport efficiency and operating constraints where authorized.
sources.limits: Complete actual flight/airport data are password-restricted; do not treat full ASPM as open.
sources.reuse_notes: Public reports and restricted products have different access conditions.

sources.name: TSA daily checkpoint volumes
sources.coverage: National screening totals.
sources.latest_period_verified: Official page blocked during research; no latest count claimed
sources.project_use: Seasonality and nationwide travel-demand context.
sources.limits: Not per-flight demand, seat availability or airport wait times. Screenings differ from boardings.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: NOAA Aviation Weather Center
sources.coverage: METAR/TAF worldwide; hazard coverage varies, including separate Alaska products.
sources.update_cadence: Product-dependent; common cache files refresh each minute
sources.project_use: Airport observations, terminal forecasts, aviation hazards, pilot reports and station metadata.
sources.limits: Use bulk caches for broad access. API history is limited; keep issue and valid times.
sources.reuse_notes: Public NOAA data; retain attribution and distinguish your derived outputs from original NOAA data.

sources.name: NWS forecasts and alerts API
sources.coverage: NWS forecast areas; validate coverage by location.
sources.project_use: Airport-area forecasts and severe-weather alerts.
sources.limits: Required application User-Agent; rate limits apply. Short retained history is not a training archive.
sources.reuse_notes: NWS describes API data as free for any purpose; respect caching and request limits.

sources.name: NOAA GHCNh hourly weather
sources.coverage: Global land stations; select U.S. airport/weather-station matches.
sources.latest_period_verified: Current replacement for ISD; documentation v1.1.0
sources.project_use: Historical wind, visibility, temperature, clouds and precipitation for delay models.
sources.limits: Keep quality flags and station history; one station is not automatically one airport.
sources.reuse_notes: Public NOAA data; retain attribution and distinguish your derived outputs from original NOAA data.

sources.name: NOAA ISD legacy hourly weather
sources.coverage: Global historical stations.
sources.project_use: Reproduce older studies or retain an existing historical pipeline.
sources.limits: Do not use an old ISD download script as the current-weather ingestion path.
sources.reuse_notes: Public NOAA data; retain attribution and distinguish your derived outputs from original NOAA data.

sources.name: Iowa State IEM airport weather archive
sources.coverage: Many U.S. and worldwide airport stations; station history varies.
sources.project_use: Convenient historical airport observations and raw METAR for research.
sources.limits: Limited quality checking; missing values have multiple causes. Keep source and station identifiers.
sources.reuse_notes: Public university archive; review current terms and cite IEM and upstream providers.

sources.name: NOAA HRRR forecasts and archive
sources.coverage: CONUS and Alaska sectors; not all U.S. islands.
sources.latest_period_verified: Current NCEP and NOAA-hosted catalog checked
sources.project_use: Short-range weather features for disruption forecasting.
sources.limits: Large volumes. Select airport areas, variables, model runs and forecast hours.
sources.reuse_notes: Public NOAA data; retain attribution and distinguish your derived outputs from original NOAA data.

sources.name: NOAA GFS forecasts
sources.coverage: Global, including Hawaii and territories.
sources.project_use: Broader weather outlook and regions outside HRRR coverage.
sources.limits: Coarse forecasts are uncertain; save the forecast as issued for honest backtests.
sources.reuse_notes: Public NOAA data; retain attribution and distinguish your derived outputs from original NOAA data.

sources.name: NOAA radar and MRMS data
sources.coverage: Product-specific radar coverage.
sources.project_use: Thunderstorm and precipitation features near airports and along routes.
sources.limits: High data volume; radar availability and product coverage vary by region.
sources.reuse_notes: Public NOAA data; retain attribution and distinguish your derived outputs from original NOAA data.

sources.name: NOAA Storm Events
sources.coverage: Reported significant U.S. weather events.
sources.latest_period_verified: Landing page checked; latest event month not confirmed
sources.project_use: Historical event labels and severe-weather case studies.
sources.limits: Retrospective reports cannot be used as information available before departure.
sources.reuse_notes: Public NOAA data; retain attribution and distinguish your derived outputs from original NOAA data.

sources.name: FAA NAS airport status
sources.coverage: Reported NAS airport delays, ground stops and closures.
sources.latest_period_verified: Official XML endpoint linked from FAA FAQ
sources.project_use: Current airport disruption flags for candidate itineraries.
sources.limits: Airport-level status is not flight-specific status. Empty or unavailable data do not prove normal operations.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA ATCSCC advisories
sources.coverage: National airspace traffic-management advisories.
sources.project_use: Ground programs, route advisories, outages and operating plans.
sources.limits: Parse issue/validity times. Text may require review; absence is not proof of no restriction.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA Temporary Flight Restrictions
sources.coverage: Published U.S. TFRs and covered territories.
sources.latest_period_verified: FAA help describes JSON/XML list export
sources.project_use: Restriction context where relevant to a flight disruption.
sources.limits: TFRs are only one subset of restrictions. Not a complete airport-closure dataset.
sources.reuse_notes: Public government release. Retain source attribution and any file-specific notices.

sources.name: FAA NOTAM / NMS data
sources.coverage: FAA NOTAM coverage; terms depend on distribution service.
sources.latest_period_verified: Current NMS API access page checked
sources.project_use: Runway, facility and airport changes affecting service.
sources.limits: Public viewing does not equal unrestricted bulk API access. NMS API access must be requested.
sources.reuse_notes: FAA access agreement and service-specific terms apply.

sources.name: FAA SWIM / SWIFT distribution
sources.coverage: Service-specific NAS flight, weather and traffic messages.
sources.project_use: Deeper disruption and operational-data research after access approval.
sources.limits: Not an anonymous REST feed. Services and reuse depend on the agreement; some services need separate requests.
sources.reuse_notes: FAA describes data as currently without subscription fees; access agreements and integration costs remain.

sources.name: OpenSky aircraft observations
sources.coverage: Receiver-dependent tracking; not complete national coverage.
sources.project_use: Observed movement research under the applicable agreement.
sources.limits: Not airline schedules. Current terms require written permission for commercial or operational API use.
sources.reuse_notes: Restricted research/education terms; OAuth2 API credentials; no automatic production reuse rights.

sources.name: OpenFlights legacy route data
sources.coverage: Historical global route snapshot.
sources.project_use: Tests or reproduction of older network research only.
sources.limits: Unsuitable for current route suggestions.
sources.reuse_notes: ODbL and Database Contents License; attribution and relevant sharing terms apply.

sources.name: OAG schedules, status and connections
sources.coverage: Commercial global schedule coverage; confirm U.S. small-carrier scope.
sources.latest_period_verified: Developer page lists limited free-tier access
sources.project_use: Future flight instances, connection rules and flight status.
sources.limits: Not open bulk data or a booking service; free-tier limits and storage/redistribution terms apply.
sources.reuse_notes: Provider subscription terms; no purchase or account created here.

sources.name: Duffel flight offers
sources.coverage: Available airline content varies by integration.
sources.latest_period_verified: Current offer and test-mode docs checked
sources.project_use: Date-specific itineraries with live offers when live access is enabled.
sources.limits: Not an open dataset. Test mode can contain unrealistic schedules and prices.
sources.reuse_notes: Commercial service terms and live-access requirements apply; no account created here.
